paragraphs.text: A community fridge is a public fridge where local shops, cafés and residents can leave food that would otherwise be thrown away. Anyone can take food for free, and volunteers check the fridge every day to remove anything past its use-by date.

items.quote: local shops, cafés and residents can leave food

explanation.en: “local shops, cafés and residents can leave food” → residents. The summary continues the same list.
explanation.kk: «local shops, cafés and residents can leave food» → residents. Түйіндегі тізім мәтіндегі тізімді жалғастырады.
explanation.ru: «local shops, cafés and residents can leave food» → residents. Перечень в пересказе продолжает перечень в тексте.

items.quote: volunteers check the fridge every day

explanation.en: “volunteers check the fridge every day” → volunteers. “Anyone” means the people who take food, not those who check.
explanation.kk: «volunteers check the fridge every day» → volunteers. «Anyone» — тоңазытқышты тексеретіндер емес, тамақ алатындар.
explanation.ru: «volunteers check the fridge every day» → volunteers. «Anyone» — те, кто берёт еду, а не проверяет холодильник.

groups.title: Sharing food
groups.summary: Food in a community fridge is left by shops, cafés and 1 ____. It is free to take, and 2 ____ check it every day.
groups.instruction: Questions 1–2. Look at the text. Complete the summary below. Choose NO MORE THAN TWO WORDS from the text for each answer.

steps.en: Limit: NO MORE THAN TWO WORDS. Gap 1 finishes the list “shops, cafés and ____”.
steps.kk: Шек — NO MORE THAN TWO WORDS. 1-бос орын «shops, cafés and ____» тізімін аяқтайды.
steps.ru: Лимит NO MORE THAN TWO WORDS. Пропуск 1 закрывает список «shops, cafés and ____».

steps.en: The text has the same list: “local shops, cafés and residents can leave food”.
steps.kk: Мәтінде дәл сол тізім: «local shops, cafés and residents can leave food».
steps.ru: В тексте тот же список: «local shops, cafés and residents can leave food».

steps.en: Answer: residents — one word, within the limit.
steps.kk: Жауап: residents — бір сөз, шектен аспайды.
steps.ru: Ответ: residents — одно слово, в пределах лимита.

steps.en: “____ check it every day” needs the people who check the fridge.
steps.kk: «____ check it every day» — тоңазытқышты тексеретін адамдар керек.
steps.ru: «____ check it every day» — нужны люди, которые проверяют холодильник.

steps.en: The text: “volunteers check the fridge every day”.
steps.kk: Мәтін: «volunteers check the fridge every day».
steps.ru: Текст: «volunteers check the fridge every day».

steps.en: “Anyone” refers to people taking food. Answer: volunteers.
steps.ru: «Anyone» относится к тем, кто берёт еду. Ответ: volunteers.
